title: The s–a relationship
slide_intent: Study counterspace between letters because the shape between forms can be as distinctive as the forms themselves.
strategic_value: A deliberate s–a relationship can preserve a recognizable feature of the Lufthansa wordmark.
demonstration: Pencil sketches examine the s and a, with shaded connecting counterforms and small Lufthansa word tests.
practical_value: Evaluate letter pairs as connected white and black shapes.
